explanation: Point generated for eta at W=1.4885 GeV, Q2=0.5, cos_th*=0.2, phi*=60 deg. Kinematically accessible at the channel default beam E=6.53 GeV (Q2=0.5 exceeds the 0.088 GeV^2 ceiling of a 1 GeV beam, so the default beam was used). The point is only 2.4 MeV above the eta-threshold (1.4861 GeV); the integrator is known to hang or return silent N/A in this region. The input file rcgrid_W1.4885-1.4885_Q20.5000-0.5000_p001.dat was written without a smoke-test run; run with a short timeout and check for a 'tai:' line in stdout to confirm viability before any grid submission.
